verdictReason: Second QA critique approved the revised specification. The detail view remains closed by default, non-functional traceability is correct, and safe diagnostic focus/fallback behavior is explicit.

issues.description: The final visual form of progressive disclosure remains a product presentation choice; inline disclosure is the documented recommendation.
issues.suggestion: Use inline disclosure unless product direction explicitly selects an accordion or inspector/drawer.

nextAction: Proceed to implementation planning using inline disclosure unless product direction overrides it.
